shared_elements: irregular carved stone surface / slab as the field
circles or discs used as filler motifs
wing- or feather-like element with repeated parallel divisions
areas of dense parallel hatching or linear texture
justification: Both are carved stone surfaces bearing profile-viewed creatures with a strongly outlined eye, disc motifs and passages of repeated parallel lines suggesting feathers or fur, which is the most specific correspondence. But A organises multiple animals into stacked horizontal registers separated by a patterned band and is rendered as rounded, naturalistic low relief, whereas B is a single large hybrid figure filling the whole irregular field in a flat, ornamental linear manner with decorative ovals.
